newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian president pledges support for sports.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian president pledges support for sports.

text.p: Tanzanian President Benjamin Mkapa has called for a national drive to raise funds to promote sports development in Tanzania and pledged more government support, the semi-official Sunday News reported.
Mkapa spoke at State House on Saturday when he met Tanzanian boxing champion and current holder of the African Super-Welterweight title Rashid Matumla.

"It's not only politics which publicises a country. Sports play a big role in promoting a good image of the country abroad," Mkapa told Matumla. Matumla won the championship belt last March after scoring a fifth-round knockout against Cameroonian Patrice Mbehnbeli.

At the ceremony, Mkapa appealed to the public, prominent business personalities and local companies to help fund sports development in Tanzania. He also promised successful sportsmen and women government support "to bring more honour to the nation."
Sports funding is low on the list of government funding priorities in Tanzania, one of the world's poorest countries, and sports facilities are scarce and often in poor repair.
